Every mark is re-derived from the text you send, so a mark the old text carried and the new text does not spell out is lost; in a discussion the text replaces the message's blocks the same way, and dropped quotes or links are named in `warnings`. Attachments and the reply target survive; the style does in a space chat. Editing another member's message is a 403.
